$comment: The BASE READING step of the layered extraction: the seven printed fields, and ONLY those. This schema was trimmed to the answer itself, so the four `analisis_*` working-notes fields the earlier design kept FIRST in the object are gone. The cost is recorded here rather than left implicit: with no analysis field to settle who the emitter is before the model commits to cuit_emisor/razon_social_emisor, the emitter-versus-recipient disambiguation now rests on the prompt's rules alone — and getting that pair wrong was measured on a real receipt that prints both its own CUIT and the customer's. Grammar-constrained generation (Ollama compiles this schema to a GBNF grammar, and the model's entire output must satisfy it) now emits exactly these seven properties, in the order declared. The other four scopes are RESERVED artifacts (`detection`, `desglose`, `rubro`, `clasificacion`). The two fields that asked *is this a receipt* live in `invoice_detection.json`, not here. It carries no critical-severity field on purpose — `importe_total_facturado` moved to the step that holds the arithmetic combination that confirms it.

tipo_comprobante.description: the letter or the AFIP code printed in the header (001 Factura A, 006 Factura B, 011 Factura C), or 'null' when the document is not a fiscal receipt. 090/099 are 'comprobantes que no cumplen la RG 1415', not receipt classes

razon_social_emisor.description: the EMITTER's name as printed in the header, without labels like 'Razon Social:' or 'Cliente:'. Checked against the source text — never the recipient's

cuit_emisor.description: the EMITTER's CUIT, digits and its own hyphens only, format XX-XXXXXXXX-X. Checked against the source text — never the recipient's. Cut the value at the first character that is not a digit or a hyphen, even if it is left incomplete

fecha_emision.description: the issue date as printed, DD/MM/YYYY. The issue date, not the due date and not the billing period

nro_comprobante.description: the receipt number printed beside 'Comp.Nro.' or 'Nro.', complete, with the hyphen if it has one. Not the point of sale, not the CAE, not an item code, not the tipo_comprobante code

moneda.description: the currency the document shows; 'ARS' when it shows none

notas.description: real observations printed on the receipt, or 'null'. Not a column header, not a running-account balance, not a summary of what you did, and not text in another language
